narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>I will bisect the straight angle on the line. That is easier to see!
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Half of a straight angle is ninety degrees, not thirty.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>We need half of the sixty degree angle instead.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Build sixty degrees, then bisect it, and side side side shows each half is thirty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Use thirty degrees to construct one hundred and fifty degrees on a line.
